title: Motion (Nazarian – McOsker, et al.) relative to instructing the Department of Building and Safety to report on the number, location, and status of priority…
text:
[Council File 26-1280]
Motion (Nazarian – McOsker, et al.) relative to instructing the Department of Building and Safety to report on the number, location, and status of priority vacant and public nuisance properties citywide, including properties that are vacant, unsecured, abandoned, fire-damaged, substantially deteriorated, littered with trash or debris, or associated with inactive construction, and establish criteria for prioritizing properties based on public safety risk, duration of nuisance conditions, surrounding community impacts, and other appropriate factors; data should be sorted by Council Districts, and the report should contain protocols and timelines of opening a vacant building abatement case and the steps that follow; and related matters.
(This item is referred to the Public Works Committee and Planning and Land Use Management Committee. The Public Works Committee approved this item on September 22, 2026.)
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
For:
North Hollywood Northeast Neighborhood Council
Studio City Neighborhood Council
Empowerment Congress Central Area Neighborhood Council
